units.source_text: 原来的女佣房间现在已经改成化妆室。

en.t: The former maid's room had now already been turned into a dressing room.

units.source_text: 在一面大镜台前，飘逸着嫂嫂身上的香味儿。

en.t: In front of a large dressing mirror, the fragrance from my sister-in-law's body drifted in the air.

units.source_text: 父亲健在的时候，嫂嫂身上是没有这股气味的。

en.t: When Father was still alive, my sister-in-law did not have that scent about her.
